files.role: Package marker for the backend module; no runtime logic.
FastAPI application factory: configures CORS, attaches platform middleware (exception handlers, request timing), registers the food router, and initialises the DB connection pool on startup.

methods.name: on_startup
methods.purpose: Calls init_pool(); logs ready or logs error and continues (matches WorkoutTracker pattern; no init_schema call — schema is pre-provisioned via migrations/001_init_schema.sql).

files.role: Postgres connection pool using psycopg2-binary. Reads ATLAS_PG_* env vars (DATABASE_URL fallback). Exposes init_pool() and get_db() context manager. Copied verbatim from WorkoutTracker backend/database.py.

methods.name: init_pool
methods.purpose: Creates a SimpleConnectionPool(minconn=1, maxconn=5) using the DSN built from ATLAS_PG_* env vars; stores it in module-level _pool.

methods.name: get_db
methods.purpose: Context manager: checks out a connection from _pool, yields it, rolls back on exception, and returns it to the pool in the finally block.

methods.name: _build_url
methods.purpose: Returns DATABASE_URL env var if set, otherwise constructs a postgresql:// DSN from ATLAS_PG_USER, ATLAS_PG_PASSWORD, ATLAS_PG_HOST, ATLAS_PG_PORT, ATLAS_PG_DB.

files.role: Package marker for the routers sub-package; no runtime logic.
All three FoodTracker HTTP endpoints. Contains the MEAL_SCHEMA constant, the private _validate_and_normalise() function, and the three route handlers.

methods.name: get_template
methods.purpose: GET /api/food/template — returns the hardcoded canonical meal JSON template string as text/plain. Template content is defined as a module-level constant TEMPLATE_JSON; never read from disk or database.

methods.name: validate_meal
methods.purpose: POST /api/food/validate — reads raw request body, calls _validate_and_normalise(), returns HTTP 200 with {preview: <normalised_dict>} on success or ApiError (HTTP 422) on any validation failure.

methods.name: commit_meal
methods.purpose: POST /api/food/meals — reads raw request body, calls _validate_and_normalise(), inserts one row into foodtracker.food_logs via get_db(), wraps the inserted row in a Dataset using MEAL_SCHEMA and returns HTTP 200. Returns ApiError HTTP 422 on validation failure, ApiError HTTP 400 on DB_CONSTRAINT (psycopg2.IntegrityError), ApiError HTTP 500 via install_exception_handlers on unexpected errors.

methods.name: _validate_and_normalise
methods.purpose: Decodes raw bytes as JSON, runs all field validation checks in the order specified in sprint definition §6.2, applies defaults and normalisation from §6.3 (defaults, dish_name derivation, kcal rounding, timestamp re-serialisation, unknown field stripping). Returns a tuple: on success, (normalised_dict, None); on any validation failure, (None, error_dict) where error_dict is an ApiError-shaped dict (code, message, detail). The route handler inspects the return value and constructs the JSONResponse (HTTP 422) itself — this function has no HTTP coupling.

files.role: Side-effect-only registration module. Calls AppRegistry.register({...}) at module scope with the FoodTracker appId, label, basePath, lazy-loaded component, and nav entries. Has no exports of any kind. The shell loads this module via a side-effect import; it never reads a named export. Do not add exports. Pattern confirmed by 03_Application/WorkoutTracker/src/shellConfig.ts.
Top-level React entry for the FoodTracker shell slot. Sets up the /food route and renders FoodIntake, which owns the idle / preview / success state machine and all API interactions.

methods.name: default
methods.purpose: Default export consumed by the shell lazy import in shellConfig.ts. Renders a React Router <Routes> with a single <Route path='/food' element={<FoodIntake />} />.

methods.name: FoodIntake
methods.purpose: Manages the three-state meal intake flow (idle | preview | success). In idle: fetches template on mount via GET /api/food/template (Skeleton while loading), renders read-only template area with 'Copy Template' button, controlled paste textarea, 'Log Meal' button (disabled in-flight), and ErrorCard on ApiError. On 'Log Meal': POST /api/food/validate; on success transitions to preview state. In preview: renders normalised field list (all 14 fields), 'Back' button (returns to idle, preserves pasted JSON), 'Accept' button (disabled in-flight), ErrorCard on ApiError. On 'Accept': POST /api/food/meals with original pasted JSON; on success transitions to success state. In success: renders confirmation (logged_at, meal_type, dish_name, kcal) and 'Log Another' button that resets to idle and clears textarea. Preview panel is a plain <dl> or <table> styled with Atlas design tokens, not DetailView.
